records.snapshot:
SYNTHETIC SNAPSHOT - simulated text for development, not an official page.
Documents you must provide (synthetic):
You must provide a current passport or other valid travel document.
You must provide a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) reference number from your course provider.
You must provide proof that you have enough money to support yourself and pay for your course.
You must provide proof of parental or legal guardian consent if you are under 18.
You must provide proof of your relationship to your parent or guardian if you are under 18.
You must provide your tuberculosis test results if you live in a country where you have to take the test.
You must provide a letter from your loan provider if you are using a student loan.
You must provide written consent from your financial sponsor if you have been sponsored.
You may need an ATAS certificate depending on your course and nationality.
